# Lastra Surfaces

> Lastra Surfaces makes custom solid stainless steel countertops: full-thickness SUS 304 (AISI 304) steel, 5mm to 10mm thick, sandblasted matte finish, fabricated to each customer's exact dimensions and shipped direct to homes and businesses across the United States and Canada. No MDF or chipboard backing, no showroom visit, no full-kitchen purchase required. Founded in 2025.

## Key facts

- Material: solid SUS 304 stainless steel (equivalent to AISI 304), the standard food-contact grade. Not sheet metal bonded over a substrate.
- Finish: sandblasted matte.
- Thicknesses and published pricing (USD per square foot):
  - 5mm: from $85/sqft. Most versatile; residential kitchens, laundry rooms, bar tops.
  - 6mm: from $100/sqft. Islands and feature counters.
  - 8mm: from $120/sqft. Commercial-adjacent and outdoor installations.
  - 10mm: from $145/sqft. Premium residential and hospitality projects.
- Sizes: any custom dimension, including L-shapes and multi-piece projects.
- Edges: square edge eased by hand to R0.8 mm (the only edge profile offered). Corners R9 mm (about 3/8", a "dime radius") standard, custom radius on request.
- L-shapes: one piece or in sections depending on overall size; sections are butted tight together at a seam.
- Add-ons: integrated welded sinks (seamless, no rim or caulk joint), faucet holes, sink and appliance cut-outs.
- Splashes: backsplashes and sidesplashes, coved one piece or stacked (glued or welded); height specified by the client.
- Lead time: 7–8 weeks from deposit to delivery (6 weeks fabrication plus 1–2 weeks freight). Rush orders are not currently available.
- Quotes: line-itemised quote within 3–4 business days of submitting measurements. No account or commitment required.
- Delivery: custom wooden freight crate, curbside delivery with tracking, to all contiguous US states and all Canadian provinces.
- Samples: 2″ × 4″ samples in each thickness, shipped in 3–5 business days; the sample cost is credited to a countertop order (valid 12 months).
- Customers: homeowners, contractors and fit-out teams, restaurants, cafés and hospitality projects.
- Contact: hello@lastrasurfaces.com
